A VPN, or Virtual Private Network, creates a secure tunnel between your device and the internet, making your online activity appear as if it originates from another location. It encrypts your data so prying eyes can't intercept it and masks your real IP address, helping you bypass geographic restrictions or hide from local network surveillance. Think of it like putting on a disguise before walking into a crowded room—nobody knows who you really are or where you're going.

Weather is what happens outside right now or over a few days—like whether it’s raining today or if there’s a heatwave this week.
